senses.en: able to change easily
able to bend easily without breaking

ex.en: Keep a flexible schedule.
ex.zh: 保持灵活的时间安排。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees balance professional responsibilities with their family commitments.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排能帮助员工兼顾工作职责与家庭责任。

col: flexible working hours｜弹性工作时间
tip: 既可形容安排灵活，也可形容材料易弯曲。

senses.en: a round juicy fruit with a large stone

ex.en: A ripe peach smells sweet.
ex.zh: 熟桃子闻着是甜的。

ex.en: She cut the peach in half, removed the stone, and shared the fruit with her niece.
ex.zh: 她把桃子切成两半，去掉核，分给侄女吃。

tip: 复数 peaches。桃核是 stone 或 pit。桃花是 peach blossom。

senses.en: a person you work with

ex.en: A colleague saved me a seat in the hall.
ex.zh: 一位同事在礼堂给我留了座位。

ex.en: She asked a colleague to read the figures before the meeting, so the chart would be accurate.
ex.zh: 她请同事在会前核对数字，好让图表准确。

col: a colleague of mine｜我的一位同事
tip: 同事是 colleague。同学是 classmate，不要混。

senses.en: a feeling of worry

ex.en: Exam anxiety is common among students.
ex.zh: 考试焦虑在学生中很常见。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can reduce anxiety among students facing demanding examinations and uncertain career prospects.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可以减轻学生面对高难度考试和不确定就业前景时的焦虑。

tip: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。

senses.en: to give something and receive something else

ex.en: Can I swap seats with you?
ex.zh: 我能和你换座位吗？

ex.en: They swap books every Friday, and each person writes one line inside the cover.
ex.zh: 他们每周五换书，每人在封面里写一行字。

col: swap sth with sb｜与某人交换
tip: swap 是口语里的交换。过去式 swapped，p 要双写。

senses.en: a serious disagreement
A situation where different needs or ideas cannot agree.
To disagree with or be incompatible with something.

ex.en: Talking can reduce family conflict.
ex.zh: 沟通可以减少家庭冲突。

ex.en: Economic growth can conflict with environmental protection when industries rely heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 当工业高度依赖化石燃料时，经济增长可能与环境保护相冲突。

col: a conflict of interest｜利益冲突
tip: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: to love and admire someone or something deeply

ex.en: The children adore the old storyteller.
ex.zh: 孩子们非常喜欢这位老讲故事的人。

ex.en: She adores early mornings at the market, when the fish is still on ice.
ex.zh: 她热爱市场的清晨，那时鱼还放在冰上。

tip: adore 比 like 强得多。adore doing sth。名词 adoration。

senses.en: to become smaller, often after washing or from fear
the process of becoming smaller

ex.en: Hot water will shrink this sweater.
ex.zh: 热水会把这件毛衣缩水。

ex.en: The lake shrank in August, and the boat club moved its rope to a nearer post.
ex.zh: 湖面八月缩小了，划船社团把绳子改系到更近的桩上。

col: shrink in the wash｜洗后缩水
tip: 过去式 shrank，过去分词 shrunk。毛衣缩水用 shrink。口语里把心理医生叫 shrink 不是本卡的义项。

senses.en: an unmarried man, or a first university degree

ex.en: He is a bachelor and cooks for himself.
ex.zh: 他是单身，自己做饭。

ex.en: He holds a bachelor of science degree, and the form asks which subject he finished.
ex.zh: 他有理学学士学位，表格问他读完的是哪个专业。

tip: 学士是 bachelor's degree。未婚女子不是 bachelor。

senses.en: a good moral quality

ex.en: Patience is a virtue in a long queue.
ex.zh: 排长队时，耐心是一种美德。

ex.en: The speech praised honesty as a virtue, then gave two examples from school life.
ex.zh: 演讲把诚实誉为美德，接着举了校园生活里的两个例子。

tip: by virtue of 表示凭借，比 because of 正式。

senses.en: to send out by radio or TV
A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.

ex.en: The match will broadcast live tonight.
ex.zh: 比赛今晚将直播。

ex.en: Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.
ex.zh: 公共电视台应播出教育节目，帮助儿童理解科学并培养学习兴趣。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

senses.en: a shape with three straight sides

ex.en: Draw a triangle and mark the right angle.
ex.zh: 画一个三角形，并标出直角。

ex.en: The roof forms a triangle, which is why rain runs off both sides so quickly.
ex.zh: 屋顶构成一个三角形，所以雨水从两侧流得很快。

tip: 三角形是 triangle。角是 angle。三边是 three sides。

senses.en: not stained by rust, or free from a moral stain

ex.en: Use the stainless pot for the soup.
ex.zh: 汤用那口不锈钢锅。

ex.en: Stainless steel spoons stay bright, while the old iron ones mark the cloth.
ex.zh: 不锈钢勺子一直发亮，旧铁勺会在布上留下印。

tip: stainless steel 是不锈钢。stain 是污渍或动词「沾污」。

senses.en: an oven that cooks with microwaves, or those waves themselves

ex.en: Reheat yesterday's rice in the microwave.
ex.zh: 把昨天的米饭放进微波炉里热一热。

ex.en: Do not put metal in the microwave, even if the bowl looks safe from the outside.
ex.zh: 不要把金属放进微波炉，哪怕碗从外面看是安全的。

tip: 日常说 the microwave 就是微波炉。金属不能放进去。微波本身是物理名词。

senses.en: violent and aggressive, or very strong

ex.en: A fierce wind bent the young trees.
ex.zh: 猛烈的风把小树吹弯了。

ex.en: The debate grew fierce, yet both sides still listened when the chair asked for quiet.
ex.zh: 辩论变得激烈，但主席要求安静时双方仍然听着。

tip: fierce 可以形容动物、风，也可以形容竞争或争论。

senses.en: easy to carry

ex.en: This portable radio fits in a school bag.
ex.zh: 这台便携收音机能放进书包。

ex.en: A portable charger kept the recording going when the hall had no socket near the stage.
ex.zh: 礼堂舞台边没有插座，便携充电器让录音得以继续。

tip: portable 强调搬得动。口袋大小更常说 pocket。

senses.en: the reflexive form of you when you means more than one

ex.en: Please time yourselves on this page.
ex.zh: 请给自己计时做这一页。

ex.en: If the map is unclear, work it out yourselves and then compare the route with the other pair.
ex.zh: 地图如果看不清，你们自己先把它弄明白，再和另一组对路线。

tip: yourselves 是 you 的复数反身代词。一个人用 yourself，不要写成 yourselfs。

senses.en: unable to stop doing something

ex.en: He is addicted to late-night videos.
ex.zh: 他迷上了深夜看视频。

ex.en: Once you are addicted to a game, set a clock and leave the screen when it rings.
ex.zh: 一旦迷上某个游戏，就定个钟，铃响了就离开屏幕。

tip: 人用 addicted，事物使人上瘾用 addictive。be addicted to sth / doing。本卡只谈学习和生活习惯。
note: 只收校园里的入迷、依赖。不写任何吸毒做法。

senses.en: a race in which each person covers one part
to pass on news or a broadcast

ex.en: Our class won the relay by a stride.
ex.zh: 我们班以一步的优势赢了接力。

ex.en: Please relay the new gate time to the other team, because their coach has no signal on the field.
ex.zh: 请把新的入场时间转达给另一队，他们的教练在场地上没有信号。

tip: 名词是接力赛。动词 relay sth to sb 是转达。接力棒叫 baton。

senses.en: a small house, especially in the country

ex.en: The reading camp is in a cottage by the lake.
ex.zh: 阅读营在湖边的一间小屋里。

ex.en: The cottage had a low door, and the tallest student had to bend to enter.
ex.zh: 小屋的门很矮，最高的学生得弯腰才能进去。

tip: cottage 是乡下的小屋。城里的公寓不是 cottage。

senses.en: a sticky substance used to join things
to join things with that substance

ex.en: This glue dries clear on paper.
ex.zh: 这种胶水在纸上干了是透明的。

ex.en: Glue the photo at the corners only, so you can lift it later without tearing the page.
ex.zh: 只在四角抹胶水，以后揭照片才不会把这一页撕破。

col: a tube of glue｜一管胶水
glue sth together｜把某物粘在一起
tip: glue 可数时是一种胶或一管胶，也可以作动词。液体胶水常不可数。

senses.en: towards the back; in the reverse order

ex.en: He spelled his name backwards as a joke.
ex.zh: 他开玩笑把自己的名字倒着拼。

ex.en: The video plays backwards if you hold this key, and the dancer seems to rise from the floor.
ex.zh: 按住这个键，视频会倒放，舞者好像从地板上站起来。

tip: 考纲里 backward 与 backwards 都单列。参考表写成 backward(s)，音标没有词尾的 /z/，本卡按 backwards 收尾补上。

senses.en: the purpose of something
To work or operate in the intended way.
A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.

ex.en: What is the function of this button?
ex.zh: 这个按钮的功能是什么？

ex.en: Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.
ex.zh: 城市公园提供运动、休闲和社交的空间，发挥着重要作用。

tip: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

senses.en: an official paper showing you have finished a course

ex.en: She framed the diploma above the desk.
ex.zh: 她把文凭裱起来挂在书桌上方。

ex.en: The diploma arrives by post next month, so the ceremony itself does not hand you the paper.
ex.zh: 文凭下个月寄到，典礼当天并不把证书交到你手上。

col: a high school diploma｜高中文凭
tip: diploma 是学历证书。diplomacy 是外交，词根相近但意思不同，不要混。

senses.en: a game in which you roll a ball at pins

ex.en: Our class booked a lane for bowling on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们班星期五订了一条保龄球道。

ex.en: Bowling looks easy until you try to hit the last pin without stepping over the line.
ex.zh: 保龄球看起来容易，等你试着不越线击中最后一只瓶就知道了。

tip: bowling 是这项运动。碗是 bowl。go bowling 中间没有 to。

senses.en: completely unreasonable or silly

ex.en: The rumour about the exam is absurd.
ex.zh: 关于考试的那个传闻很荒谬。

ex.en: It is absurd to blame the rain for a mistake that was written into the plan.
ex.zh: 计划里写错的东西，却怪到下雨头上，这太荒谬了。

tip: absurd 语气重，表示完全说不通。名词 absurdity。

senses.en: a worry or interest

senses.zh: 令人担忧的事；关注事项
senses.en: An issue that matters or causes worry
To relate to someone or something, or cause worry

ex.en: Health is a shared concern for all.
ex.zh: 健康是所有人共同的关切。

ex.en: Growing concern about air pollution has encouraged many cities to invest in cleaner public transport systems.
ex.zh: 人们对空气污染日益担忧，促使许多城市投资建设更清洁的公共交通系统。

col: concern about safety｜对安全的担忧
a major concern｜一个主要问题
concern for others｜对他人的关心
tip: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

senses.en: to refuse to buy something or take part, as a protest
that kind of protest

ex.en: Some readers boycott the unfair magazine.
ex.zh: 有些读者抵制那份不公平的杂志。

ex.en: The boycott of plastic bottles lasted a month and pushed the canteen to offer jugs of water.
ex.zh: 抵制塑料瓶持续了一个月，食堂因此改供应大壶水。

col: call for a boycott｜呼吁抵制
tip: boycott 可作动词或名词。它是公开的集体拒绝，不是偷偷破坏。

senses.en: a formal style of dancing on the toes

ex.en: She has ballet practice on Thursday evening.
ex.zh: 她周四晚上练芭蕾。

ex.en: The school ballet tells an old story, and the dancers made their own paper trees.
ex.zh: 学校的芭蕾讲一个老故事，舞者自己做了纸树。

tip: 芭蕾的 t 不发音，末尾读 /eɪ/。

senses.en: based on theory, not on practice

ex.en: The theoretical result did not match the lab reading.
ex.zh: 理论结果和实验读数对不上。

ex.en: A theoretical model is useful only if someone later tests it with real data.
ex.zh: 理论模型只有后来有人用真实数据检验，才有用。

tip: theoretical 对 practical。名词 theory。

senses.en: to agree to do a task, or to start it

ex.en: We undertake the cleaning every Friday.
ex.zh: 我们每个星期五负责打扫。

ex.en: The college will undertake a survey of the playground before any new paint is bought.
ex.zh: 学院会在购买新涂料之前先对操场做调查。

col: undertake a task｜承担一项任务
tip: undertake to do sth 是答应去做。过去式 undertook，过去分词 undertaken。

senses.en: to break out of an egg, or to make an egg do that
an opening in a ship or aircraft floor

ex.en: The chicks hatch near the warm lamp.
ex.zh: 小鸡在暖灯旁出壳。

ex.en: Three eggs hatch by Friday, and the farmer will move those chicks into a dry box.
ex.zh: 有三枚蛋星期五孵出来，农场主会把那些小鸡挪进干燥的箱子。

col: hatch a plan｜策划一个计划
tip: 第一义是孵出。hatch a plan 是暗中策划。名词 hatch 还可指船上的舱口。

senses.en: a small piece of thick material that lies on the floor or a table

ex.en: Leave wet shoes on the mat.
ex.zh: 湿鞋放在垫子上。

ex.en: He rolled the exercise mat after practice so nobody would trip in the dark corridor.
ex.zh: 训练后他把运动垫卷起来，免得有人在暗走廊里绊倒。

tip: mat 是小垫子。床垫是 mattress，大得多。不要和 maths 混在一个词里。

senses.en: unable to walk well, or weak as an excuse

ex.en: The lame dog waited by the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 那只跛脚的狗等在厨房门口。

ex.en: Saying he forgot the date is a lame excuse, because the notice has been up all week.
ex.zh: 说自己忘了日期站不住脚，通知已经贴了整整一周。

col: a lame excuse｜站不住脚的借口
lame in one leg｜一条腿瘸
tip: 形容腿是跛。形容借口是站不住脚。后一种很常见。

senses.en: a branch of mathematics that uses letters for numbers

ex.en: Algebra uses letters for unknown numbers.
ex.zh: 代数用字母表示未知数。

ex.en: In algebra we solve for x, and we show each step so a classmate can follow it.
ex.zh: 代数课上我们求 x，并且把每一步写出来，让同学跟得上。

tip: 学科名前通常不加 the：study algebra。形容词 algebraic。

senses.en: a small change that makes something better

ex.en: One adjustment made the chair comfortable.
ex.zh: 调了一下，椅子就舒服了。

ex.en: A small adjustment to the timetable let the lab group finish before the bus left.
ex.zh: 时间表稍作调整，实验小组就能在车开走前做完。

tip: adjustment 是名词。动词 adjust 已在本库。

senses.en: written forms and records that a job requires

ex.en: The paperwork took the whole afternoon.
ex.zh: 文书工作占了整整一下午。

ex.en: Finish the paperwork before Friday, or the exchange office cannot hold your place.
ex.zh: 星期五之前把文书做完，否则交流办公室留不住你的名额。

tip: paperwork 不可数。一份表格是 a form，成堆的手续才是 paperwork。

senses.en: clothes to be washed, or a place that washes them

ex.en: The dorm laundry closes at nine.
ex.zh: 宿舍洗衣房九点关门。

ex.en: Her laundry was still damp at breakfast, so she wore yesterday's shirt.
ex.zh: 早饭时她要洗的衣服还是潮的，于是她穿了昨天的衬衫。

tip: laundry 既可以是待洗的衣服，也可以是洗衣的地方。

senses.en: a small long soft creature with no legs

ex.en: A worm crossed the wet path.
ex.zh: 一条蚯蚓爬过湿漉漉的小路。

ex.en: Birds pull a worm from the soil after rain, which the biology note asks you to describe.
ex.zh: 雨后鸟会从土里拽出蚯蚓，生物笔记让你描写这一点。

col: a worm in the apple｜苹果里的虫
tip: 蚯蚓常说 earthworm，泛指小软虫用 worm。电脑里的 worm 是蠕虫病毒，看上下文。

senses.en: the state of being away
a situation in which something does not exist or occur

ex.en: His absence from class worried the teacher.
ex.zh: 他缺课让老师担心。

ex.en: In the absence of reliable public transport, many residents have little choice but to drive.
ex.zh: 在缺乏可靠公共交通的情况下，许多居民别无选择，只能开车。

col: in someone's absence｜在某人不在时
in the absence of｜在缺乏……的情况下
tip: 缺席某活动用absence from；缺乏某物用absence of。

senses.en: a person who carries bags, or who watches a door

ex.en: The porter carried our bags to the train.
ex.zh: 搬运工把行李送到了火车上。

ex.en: Ask the porter at the gate whether the hall stays open after nine.
ex.zh: 问问门口的门房，礼堂九点后还开不开。

tip: 车站帮你拿箱子的，和守门的，考纲里都可以是 porter。

senses.en: a place where a dead person is buried, often with a stone

ex.en: The old tomb is closed to visitors.
ex.zh: 那座古墓不对参观者开放。

ex.en: Flowers on the tomb are replaced each spring by students from the nearest school.
ex.zh: 墓上的花每年春天由最近那所学校的学生更换。

tip: tomb 的 b 不发音。墓碑常说 tombstone，一个词。

senses.en: happening all the time
remaining the same over time
a value or quantity that does not change

ex.en: There is constant noise from the street.
ex.zh: 街上有持续的噪音。

ex.en: Maintaining a constant temperature in public buildings can improve comfort but may increase energy consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑保持恒温可以提高舒适度，但可能增加能源消耗。

tip: 可指持续发生，也可指数值不变，须看语境。

senses.en: made by people, not natural
Not sincere or natural in appearance or behaviour

ex.en: artificial light can hurt sleep.
ex.zh: 人造光可能影响睡眠。

ex.en: Excessive artificial lighting in urban areas can disrupt wildlife behaviour and reduce the visibility of stars.
ex.zh: 城市中过量的人工照明会扰乱野生动物的行为，并使星星难以看清。

tip: artificial指人造的；artistic才是艺术的。

senses.en: to give out
to spread something over an area

ex.en: Volunteers distribute food to the poor.
ex.zh: 志愿者向穷人分发食物。

ex.en: Governments must distribute healthcare resources fairly so that rural communities receive the same quality of care as urban residents.
ex.zh: 政府必须公平分配医疗资源，让农村社区享有与城市居民同等质量的医疗服务。

tip: distribute A to B 表示“把A分发给B”。

senses.en: to give for a purpose
To help cause a particular result
To write material for a publication or website

ex.en: Everyone can contribute to the project.
ex.zh: 每个人都能为这个项目做贡献。

ex.en: Limited access to affordable housing can contribute to social inequality and force workers to accept longer commutes.
ex.zh: 难以获得可负担住房可能加剧社会不平等，并迫使劳动者接受更长的通勤时间。

col: contribute to a discussion｜参与讨论
contribute to economic growth｜促进经济增长
tip: contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: total; complete
not limited by conditions, rules, or other authorities

ex.en: He has absolute confidence in the team.
ex.zh: 他对团队有绝对信心。

ex.en: Giving any single institution absolute power can weaken accountability and reduce public trust in government.
ex.zh: 赋予任何单一机构不受限制的权力，都可能削弱问责机制并降低公众对政府的信任。

col: an absolute necessity｜绝对必需的事物
tip: 常表示程度已达极限，通常不用 very 修饰。

senses.en: a person who speaks officially for a group

ex.en: The spokesman read a short statement.
ex.zh: 发言人宣读了一份简短声明。

ex.en: A spokesman for the museum said the dinosaur hall will reopen after the roof is dry.
ex.zh: 博物馆发言人说，屋顶干了以后恐龙馆会重新开放。

tip: spokesman 传统上指男性。女性是 spokeswoman，中性说法是 spokesperson。复数 spokesmen。

senses.en: to travel on water using sails or a boat
a sheet of cloth that catches the wind

ex.en: They sail on the lake when the wind is steady.
ex.zh: 风稳定时他们在湖上航行。

ex.en: A red sail showed beyond the pier, then disappeared behind the boathouse.
ex.zh: 码头外露出一面红帆，然后消失在船库后面。

tip: 本卡动词在前。帆是名词 sail。开船的人是 sailor，不要和 sail 当成同一个词。

senses.en: to decide firmly; to find out
To control or strongly influence what happens.
To make a firm decision to do something.

ex.en: Tests help determine your progress.
ex.zh: 测试有助于测定你的进步。

ex.en: Researchers must determine whether smaller classes improve learning outcomes before governments invest heavily in additional teaching staff.
ex.zh: 在政府投入大量资金增聘教师之前，研究人员必须确定小班教学是否能改善学习成果。

tip: determine whether 意为查明是否；后接从句。

senses.en: not guilty; pure
Lacking experience or knowledge of unpleasant aspects of life.
Not intended to hurt, offend, or cause trouble.

ex.en: The child looked innocent.
ex.zh: 孩子看上去很天真。

ex.en: A fair legal system must protect innocent people while ensuring that those responsible for crimes face justice.
ex.zh: 公平的法律制度必须保护无辜者，同时确保犯罪者受到法律制裁。

col: innocent of a crime｜未犯某罪
tip: 表示未犯某罪用innocent of，不用innocent from。

senses.en: a shop selling food and household goods

ex.en: We stopped at the grocery for milk and eggs.
ex.zh: 我们在杂货店停下，买了牛奶和鸡蛋。

ex.en: The grocery on the corner closes at nine, later than the school canteen.
ex.zh: 拐角的杂货店九点关门，比学校食堂晚。

tip: 参考表没有单独的 grocery。常见说法是 a grocery 或 a grocery store，卖食品和日用品。

senses.en: based on chance or personal wish, not on a fair reason

ex.en: The order of names looked arbitrary.
ex.zh: 名单的顺序看起来很随意。

ex.en: An arbitrary rule that ignores the written guide will be hard for the class to accept.
ex.zh: 一条不顾书面说明、只凭武断的规定，全班很难接受。

tip: arbitrary 强调没有正当理由。random 只是随机，不一定武断。副词是 arbitrarily。

senses.en: extremely good

ex.en: The view from the old tower was superb.
ex.zh: 旧塔上的景色好极了。

ex.en: Reviewers called the performance superb, and the choir was asked to sing it again.
ex.zh: 评论称演出极好，合唱团被请来再唱一遍。

tip: superb 语气很强，比 good 高一档。重音在第二音节。

senses.en: a surprising chance happening

ex.en: It was a coincidence that we wore the same tie.
ex.zh: 我们系了同一条领带，纯属巧合。

ex.en: By coincidence both stories begin on a rainy night in a station, though the writers never met.
ex.zh: 巧合的是两个故事都始于车站的雨夜，尽管两位作者从未见过面。

tip: by coincidence 作状语。不要说 a coincidence chance。

senses.en: a narrow street or path between buildings

ex.en: The bakery is down a narrow alley.
ex.zh: 面包店在一条窄巷里。

ex.en: Lights were added in the alley so students could walk home without crossing the main road.
ex.zh: 巷子里加了灯，学生回家就不必穿过大路。

tip: 小巷是 alley。盲巷、死胡同是 a blind alley，也可比喻行不通的办法。

senses.en: the height of something above sea level

ex.en: The town sits at a high altitude.
ex.zh: 这座小镇海拔很高。

ex.en: At that altitude the air is thin, so the team walked slowly and drank more water.
ex.zh: 那个高度空气稀薄，队伍走得慢，水也喝得更多。

col: at an altitude of｜在…的高度
tip: altitude 多指海拔。态度是 attitude，只差一个字母。

senses.en: the main points of something, or its outer shape
to give the main points

ex.en: An outline comes first, then the full essay.
ex.zh: 先有大纲，再写全文。

ex.en: The teacher outlined the chapter in five points, then left us to read the examples.
ex.zh: 老师用五点概述了这一章，然后让我们自己读例子。

tip: 名词 outline 是提纲或轮廓。动词是「概述」，例句里可用 outlined。

senses.en: words printed under a picture, or on a screen

ex.en: The caption names every person in the photo.
ex.zh: 说明文字写出了照片里的每个人。

ex.en: Turn on the caption if the film is quiet, so the back row can still follow the story.
ex.zh: 电影声音小时打开字幕，后排也能跟上情节。

tip: 图下的说明是 caption。影片字幕也可以说 captions，英式还说 subtitles。

senses.en: to judge the quality or value of something

ex.en: Two teachers assess the oral test together so one opinion does not decide it.
ex.zh: 两位老师一起评定口试，避免一个人说了算。

ex.en: We assess a source by asking who wrote it and whether the date is clear.
ex.zh: 我们评价一份资料，会问是谁写的、日期是否清楚。

tip: assess 是作出评价。名词 assessment。不要和 access（进入）搞混。

senses.en: the country you come from

ex.en: She wrote poems about her homeland.
ex.zh: 她写诗写自己的故乡。

ex.en: He returned to his homeland after university and taught in the school he once attended.
ex.zh: 大学毕业后他回到故乡，在自己曾经就读的学校教书。

col: return to one's homeland｜回到故乡
tip: homeland 可指祖国，也可指故乡那一片土地。

senses.en: a sudden feeling of excitement
to make someone feel that

ex.en: The goal gave the crowd a thrill.
ex.zh: 这个进球让观众激动起来。

ex.en: It still thrills her to hear the violin from the stairwell at the end of practice.
ex.zh: 训练结束时从楼梯间听见小提琴，仍然让她激动。

col: the thrill of victory｜胜利时的激动
tip: 人感到激动用 thrilled，事物令人激动用 thrilling。thriller 是惊险故事，不是形容词。

senses.en: to clean a floor with a broom

ex.en: Please sweep the classroom after the party.
ex.zh: 聚会结束后请把教室扫一扫。

ex.en: They sweep the leaves off the path each morning before the gates open.
ex.zh: 他们每天早上开门前把小路上的叶子扫掉。

tip: 过去式和过去分词都是 swept。扫帚是 broom。

senses.en: to make something clearer and easier to understand

ex.en: Could you clarify the second step?
ex.zh: 你能把第二步说清楚吗？

ex.en: The editor asked him to clarify who paid for the trip before the article went into the paper.
ex.zh: 编辑让他在文章见报前说明这次出行是谁出的钱。

tip: clarify 后面接名词。名词 clarification。clear 是形容词，clarify 是动词。

senses.en: a heavy metal object that keeps a boat in place
to lower the anchor

ex.en: The boat dropped its anchor near the wooden dock.
ex.zh: 船在木码头附近抛了锚。

ex.en: They anchored in a shallow bay because the wind was too strong for the open water.
ex.zh: 风太大，不适合去开阔水面，他们在一个浅湾抛了锚。

tip: 参考表是锚、抛锚。新闻主播也叫 anchor，本卡不收。

senses.en: a fastener that joins two edges of cloth

ex.en: The zip on this coat is stuck.
ex.zh: 这件外套的拉链卡住了。

ex.en: Pull the zip slowly, or the cloth will catch and the coat will not close.
ex.zh: 拉链要慢慢拉，不然布会卡住，外套就合不上。

tip: 英式里 zip 常指拉链。美式邮政编码是 zip code。动词 zip up 是拉上拉链。

senses.en: expecting that good things will happen

ex.en: She stays optimistic even when the score is low.
ex.zh: 比分落后时她仍然乐观。

ex.en: An optimistic plan still needs a second bus, in case the first one is full.
ex.zh: 乐观的计划也要留第二辆车，以防第一辆坐满。

tip: optimistic about sth。名词 optimism。反义 pessimistic。

senses.en: an arch of colors in the sky after rain

ex.en: A rainbow stood over the playground after the shower.
ex.zh: 阵雨后一道彩虹挂在操场上空。

ex.en: We stopped the bus to photograph the rainbow, and it faded before everyone was ready.
ex.zh: 我们让车停下拍彩虹，还没等大家都准备好，它就淡了。

tip: rainbow 是一个词。雨后对着太阳的方向才容易看见。

senses.en: excellent, or very impressive to look at

ex.en: What a splendid catch at the back.
ex.zh: 后场这一接太漂亮了。

ex.en: The splendid view from the tower lasted only until clouds covered the far hills.
ex.zh: 塔上的壮丽景色只持续到云挡住远山为止。

tip: splendid 既可以夸景色，也可以夸主意或表现。语气比 good 强。

senses.en: suitable
to take something for your own use without permission
to officially set aside money for a particular purpose

ex.en: Wear appropriate clothes for the interview.
ex.zh: 面试穿合适的衣服。

ex.en: Governments should provide appropriate training to help workers adapt to technological changes in the labour market.
ex.zh: 政府应提供适当培训，帮助劳动者适应劳动力市场中的技术变革。

tip: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词读/eɪt/。

senses.en: ease of use
Something that makes daily life easier.

ex.en: Online shopping offers great convenience.
ex.zh: 网购提供极大便利。

ex.en: Although online shopping offers convenience, it may encourage unnecessary spending and increase packaging waste.
ex.zh: 虽然网上购物带来了便利，但它可能助长不必要的消费，并增加包装垃圾。

tip: 表示“方便”通常不可数；形容词是convenient。

senses.en: to run somewhere very quickly
a short fast run

ex.en: We dash to the canteen if the break is short.
ex.zh: 课间短的时候，我们冲向食堂。

ex.en: He made a dash for the closing door and still had to wait for the next lift.
ex.zh: 他朝正在关上的门冲过去，结果还是得等下一趟电梯。

tip: dash 是短而快的跑。a dash of 也可以表示少许，参考表这一行是快跑、冲刺。

senses.en: the bright burning gas of a fire

ex.en: Keep your sleeve away from the flame.
ex.zh: 袖子离火焰远一点。

ex.en: The flame turned yellow when the air hole was closed, so we opened it again.
ex.zh: 气孔关上时火焰变黄了，于是我们又打开。

tip: 参考表还写了「光辉」。本卡先记看得见的火焰。

senses.en: older, of people in a family
an older person

ex.en: My elder sister starts university this autumn.
ex.zh: 我姐姐今年秋天上大学。

ex.en: The village elders sat at the front and listened to the students' report.
ex.zh: 村里的长者坐在前排，听学生们的汇报。

tip: 家庭里年长的用 elder：elder sister。更老的物品一般用 older，不用 elder。

senses.en: a result of an action
The quality of being important or worth considering.

ex.en: Every choice has a consequence.
ex.zh: 每个选择都有后果。

ex.en: One serious consequence of rapid urban growth is increased pressure on public transport and housing.
ex.zh: 城市快速扩张的一个严重后果是公共交通和住房承受的压力增大。

tip: as a consequence of后接原因，意为“由于”。

senses.en: to give money or goods to help

ex.en: Our class donated winter coats to the community center.
ex.zh: 我们班把冬衣捐给了社区中心。

ex.en: She donated the prize money to the library so it could buy more science books.
ex.zh: 她把奖金捐给图书馆，用来多买科学书。

tip: 参考表没有 donate。donate sth to sb/sth。名词 donation。

senses.en: an activity you do for pleasure

ex.en: The recreation room has a piano and two board games.
ex.zh: 娱乐室里有一架钢琴和两套棋牌。

ex.en: Swimming is his only recreation during exams, twenty minutes and then back to the desk.
ex.zh: 考试期间他唯一的消遣是游泳，游二十分钟再回到书桌前。

tip: recreation 是放松的活动。re-creation 加连字符才是「再创造」。

senses.en: a public room where people can sit and relax

ex.en: Passengers wait in the lounge upstairs.
ex.zh: 旅客在楼上的休息室等候。

ex.en: The teachers' lounge has a kettle and a few chairs, but no space for a meeting.
ex.zh: 教师休息室有水壶和几把椅子，但开不了会。

tip: lounge 是可以坐着休息的公共房间。动词 lounge about 是闲荡。

senses.en: not occupied or filled

ex.en: The vacant seat is beside the window.
ex.zh: 空位在窗边。

ex.en: A vacant shop on the corner has been empty since winter, and the sign is still up.
ex.zh: 拐角的空店从冬天起就没人，牌子还挂着。

tip: vacant 常指座位、房间、职位空着。名词 vacancy。人离开腾地方是 vacate。

senses.en: to leave or give up
To stop doing or pursuing something before it is finished.
A lack of restraint in expressing feelings or enjoying yourself.

ex.en: We had to abandon the plan after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后我们不得不放弃那个计划。

ex.en: Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
ex.zh: 城市不应仅因初期参与率低于预期，就放弃雄心勃勃的回收计划。

tip: abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。

senses.en: a person walking in the street
for people on foot, or dull

ex.en: A pedestrian waited at the crossing.
ex.zh: 一位行人在人行横道边等着。

ex.en: The pedestrian bridge keeps walkers above the traffic at the school corner.
ex.zh: 天桥让步行的人从学校拐角的车流上方过去。

tip: 行人是 pedestrian。人行横道是 a pedestrian crossing，美式也说 crosswalk。作形容词还可以表示平淡。

senses.en: of the face

ex.en: The facial cream stung the cut on his cheek.
ex.zh: 这款面部乳膏刺痛了他脸颊上的伤口。

ex.en: Facial expressions in the video told us who was nervous before anyone spoke.
ex.zh: 视频里的面部表情在开口之前就告诉了我们谁紧张。

tip: 参考表写「面部用的」，本卡收作形容词「面部的」。face 是名词。

senses.en: a person who has at least a million pounds or dollars

ex.en: The story's millionaire still rides a bicycle.
ex.zh: 故事里的百万富翁仍然骑自行车。

ex.en: Becoming a millionaire is not the aim of the club; paying for the bus is.
ex.zh: 成为百万富翁不是社团的目标，凑齐车费才是。

col: become a millionaire｜成为百万富翁
a millionaire businessman｜百万富翁商人
tip: millionaire 是拥有百万（货币）的人。百万这个数是 million。

senses.en: a school for very young children

ex.en: Kindergarten ends at three in this town.
ex.zh: 这个镇的幼儿园三点放学。

ex.en: The kindergarten keeps a spare coat by the door because the children forget theirs.
ex.zh: 幼儿园在门口放一件备用外套，因为孩子们会忘带自己的。

fam: kindergartener (n. 幼儿园小朋友；幼儿教师)
tip: 高考里常把 kindergarten 译成幼儿园。美式多指上一年级前的那一年，大约五岁，不是整个学前阶段。英式幼儿班更常说 nursery。

senses.en: the part of mathematics about shapes and space

ex.en: Geometry homework is on page forty.
ex.zh: 几何作业在第四十页。

ex.en: In geometry we proved that the angles of a triangle add up to 180 degrees.
ex.zh: 几何课上我们证明了三角形的内角和是 180 度。

tip: 几何是 geometry。地理是 geography。两词都长，不要看混。

senses.en: easy to understand, or honest and direct

ex.en: The instructions are straightforward.
ex.zh: 这些说明简单明了。

ex.en: Give a straightforward answer about the missing key, even if the truth is awkward.
ex.zh: 丢失的钥匙要坦率回答，哪怕实情让人难堪。

col: a straightforward task｜一项直截了当的任务
tip: straightforward 指不绕弯、好懂。它不是 straight 和 forward 的简单相加，但可以这样帮助记忆。

senses.en: sending out harmful energy from the nucleus of an atom

ex.en: Radioactive samples stay in a locked cupboard.
ex.zh: 放射性样品放在上锁的柜子里。

ex.en: The sign says the waste is radioactive, so students do not open the yellow box.
ex.zh: 牌子写着这些废物有放射性，所以学生不要打开黄盒子。

tip: radioactive 形容物质会放出辐射。名词 radioactivity。课堂只讲标志和安全，不涉及武器。
note: 只收课本里的放射性与安全标志。

senses.en: a machine that records sound, or a simple wind instrument

ex.en: The recorder captured the whole interview.
ex.zh: 录音机把整段采访录了下来。

ex.en: In music class the recorder is a wind instrument, not the machine on the shelf.
ex.zh: 音乐课上的 recorder 是竖笛，不是架子上那台机器。

tip: recorder 在旧课本里多是录音机，在音乐课上常是竖笛。看句子才能确定。动词是 record。

senses.en: related to a cube, or measured in cubes

ex.en: The tank holds two cubic metres.
ex.zh: 水箱能装两立方米。

ex.en: Label the carton 240 cubic centimetres after you measure its length, width and height.
ex.zh: 量完长、宽、高之后，在纸箱上标 240 立方厘米。

tip: 立方米是 a cubic metre。立方体本身是 cube，本库另有一条。

senses.en: to raise the hand to the head as a sign of respect, or to honour someone
that sign

ex.en: Soldiers salute when the flag is raised.
ex.zh: 升旗时士兵敬礼。

ex.en: The letter is a salute to the nurses who stayed on duty through the storm.
ex.zh: 这封信向暴风雨中仍然值班的护士致敬。

tip: salute 可以是军礼，也可以是书面上的致敬。书信开头的称呼是 salutation，比 salute 正式。

senses.en: physical education as a school subject

ex.en: PE is on the field this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午的体育课在操场。

ex.en: Bring trainers for PE, because the hall floor is too smooth for ordinary shoes.
ex.zh: 体育课带运动鞋，礼堂地面太滑，普通鞋不合适。

tip: 考纲里的 PE 就是体育课，读作两个字母。带点的 P.E. 仍在词表里，Zipf 更低，本批不收。
note: 词头按考纲写作 PE。P.E. 是另一条，不在本窗口。

senses.en: to change food in the stomach, or to understand information fully
a short account of a longer text

ex.en: Walk slowly while you digest a large meal.
ex.zh: 大餐之后慢慢走一走，帮助消化。

ex.en: Digest the article tonight, and tomorrow write a digest of no more than eighty words.
ex.zh: 今晚把这篇文章读懂，明天写一篇不超过八十字的摘要。

tip: 第一义是动词：消化或领会。名词 digest 是文摘、摘要。形容词 digestive，名词 digestion。

senses.en: a piece of underwear, or a sleeveless jacket

ex.en: He wore a vest under the shirt.
ex.zh: 他在衬衫里面穿了一件汗衫。

ex.en: The orange vest makes the volunteer easy to see when cars pass the school gate.
ex.zh: 橙色背心让志愿者在车辆经过校门时容易被看见。

tip: 英式 vest 常指内衣汗衫。美式 vest 多指西装背心，英式叫 waistcoat。安全背心两边都说 vest。

senses.en: a small strong vehicle for rough roads

ex.en: The jeep climbed the farm track.
ex.zh: 吉普车爬上了农场小路。

ex.en: A green jeep carried the tents as far as the mud, and we walked the rest.
ex.zh: 一辆绿色吉普车把帐篷运到泥地边上，剩下的路我们步行。

tip: 课本里的 jeep 指适合烂路的小越野车。它原是商标，考试按普通名词理解即可。

senses.en: the force that slows sliding, or disagreement between people

ex.en: Friction keeps the shoes from sliding.
ex.zh: 摩擦力让鞋不打滑。

ex.en: Friction between the two clubs faded after they shared the same practice hour.
ex.zh: 两个社团之间的摩擦在共用同一个训练时段之后消退了。

col: friction between｜……之间的摩擦或不和
tip: 物理里 friction 是摩擦力。人与人之间的摩擦、不和也用这个词。

senses.en: a game in which players mark numbers and shout when they finish

ex.en: Bingo night is in the school hall.
ex.zh: 宾戈之夜在学校礼堂。

ex.en: She shouted bingo only after checking every number against the card in her hand.
ex.zh: 她对照手里的卡片核对了每个数字，才喊宾戈。

tip: 喊 Bingo! 表示这一张卡完成了。它是游戏名，也是那一声喊。

senses.en: a flat plastic disc that stores music or data

ex.en: This compact disk holds the whole concert.
ex.zh: 这张光盘装着整场音乐会。

ex.en: Scratch a compact disk and the last song may jump, so keep it in the case.
ex.zh: 光盘划伤了，最后一首歌可能会跳，所以放回盒子里。

col: a compact disk player｜光盘播放机
tip: 考纲写 compact disk，两个词。缩写 CD 已在库里。disk 的美式拼写也已单列。
note: 词头是两个词 compact disk。目录 id 为 compact-disk。
